title: DataSense headers should behave as the WSC ones
description: The headers of a given WSDL file should be represented the same way as the WSC:  1) they must follow the """"soap."""" prefix convention  2) different from WSC, the input metadata of a flow should have headers in the INBOUND rather the OUTBOUND (as we are exposing the SOAP service). Right now, for the input on any SOAPKit flow, headers are expected to be consumed as OUTBOUND properties, when it should be the other way around: INBOUND. Same applies for the output
